schedule: trial-major; degree order 2,4,8,16; adjacent AB/BA alternating by trial

argv: import z3; from importlib.metadata import version; print(version("python-flint"), z3.get_version_string())

comparison.statistic: per-degree median (mean of the middle two sorted values) and full range of six paired eager/clean ratios
comparison.direction_rule: consistent direction only if all six ratios are strictly on the same side of 1; otherwise mixed/inconclusive
comparison.rerun_policy: one fixed capture; no rerun for an inconclusive result; at most one unchanged recapture after an operational failure, retaining all completed arms and failed attempts
comparison.inference: descriptive shared-host observations, no significance or asymptotic verdict

regime: one Rat extension, head leading coefficient 2, 2n products; stored eager denominators at most 4; unique selected root uses direct Sturm rather than BKR; degree 2 uses the linear endpoint fast path; no normalization policy conclusion
registration_purpose: fixed exact-result comparison endpoints in a short product-chain regime; no policy, scaling or absolute-budget verdict
